$schema_note: PubChem CACTVS Substructure Fingerprint (881 bits) bit definitions, parsed from the official NCBI specification 'PubChem Substructure Fingerprint V1.3' (http://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov). Sections 3-7 (bits 263-880) are drawable SMARTS patterns taken verbatim (or lightly re-bracketed for RDKit SMARTS syntax) from the spec. Section 1 (bits 0-114) are single-element atom counts ('>= N <element>' over the WHOLE molecule) - drawn as a single query atom; the count threshold itself has no fixed substructure to draw and is kept only in 'description'. Section 2 (bits 115-262) are ring COUNT/property rules (e.g. '>= 2 aromatic rings') with no single fixed-topology substructure - not drawable (drawable=false, smarts/smiles left empty); 'description' still carries the exact rule.
